'''J-9SB''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that acted as an informal ambassador at the [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The glossy-[[black]] plated [[Droid/Legends|droid]] tended to the needs of visiting VIPs while also serving as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] searching for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] custom [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]].
